description: The Water Institute of the Gulf — Port Fourchon: Supporting Resiliency on an Evolving Coast is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by The Water Institute of the Gulf; Partnership for Our Working Coast. To ensure community support for nature-based reuse of dredged material in Port Fourchon, the Water Institute of the Gulf developed an outreach and engagement plan and worked with public and private partners to gather stakeholder input and potential project designs and sites. Coverage: the United States (2022). The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
